name: runtime-evidence-workspace
description: Runtime verification evidence for pull requests

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:scaffold && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test: node --test tests/workspace.test.ts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:examples && npm run test:acceptance
